svg.aria-label: How to write salvē: 5 letters, s, a, l, v, ē, one after another
svg.title: Writing salvē
svg.desc: 5 letters written one after another: s, a, l, v, ē (latin). Each letter has its own group of frames; frame N of a group shows movements 1 to N of that letter, the movement being added drawn in ink over the finished letter, whose outline is read from _fonts/LatinPrint-Subset.ttf. Each letter is drawn at its own scale from its own cited stroke order, so the strip does not show how large the letters are next to each other, how far apart they sit, or any join between them. Stroke order: s: Grundschrift-App (Laborschule Bielefeld, Bielefeld University, with the Grundschulverband), level kleinbuchstaben/s, ordered stroke paths for s (assets/levels/kleinbuchstaben/s/metadata.json, commit f6dbd80; no licence, facts only) <https://github.com/Medien-Treibhaus/grundschrift-app-source/blob/f6dbd807adbb3fc2f94207fe578def439f6e9c49/assets/levels/kleinbuchstaben/s/metadata.json>; a: Grundschrift-App (Laborschule Bielefeld, Bielefeld University, with the Grundschulverband), level kleinbuchstaben/a, ordered stroke paths for a (assets/levels/kleinbuchstaben/a/metadata.json, commit f6dbd80; no licence, facts only) <https://github.com/Medien-Treibhaus/grundschrift-app-source/blob/f6dbd807adbb3fc2f94207fe578def439f6e9c49/assets/levels/kleinbuchstaben/a/metadata.json>; l: Grundschrift-App (Laborschule Bielefeld, Bielefeld University, with the Grundschulverband), level kleinbuchstaben/l, ordered stroke paths for l (assets/levels/kleinbuchstaben/l/metadata.json, commit f6dbd80; no licence, facts only) <https://github.com/Medien-Treibhaus/grundschrift-app-source/blob/f6dbd807adbb3fc2f94207fe578def439f6e9c49/assets/levels/kleinbuchstaben/l/metadata.json>; v: Grundschrift-App (Laborschule Bielefeld, Bielefeld University, with the Grundschulverband), level kleinbuchstaben/v, ordered stroke paths for v (assets/levels/kleinbuchstaben/v/metadata.json, commit f6dbd80; no licence, facts only) <https://github.com/Medien-Treibhaus/grundschrift-app-source/blob/f6dbd807adbb3fc2f94207fe578def439f6e9c49/assets/levels/kleinbuchstaben/v/metadata.json>; ē: By analogy with the cited é and ñ, not separately sourced: the e after the Grundschrift-App, level kleinbuchstaben/e (assets/levels/kleinbuchstaben/e/metadata.json, commit f6dbd80; no licence, facts only), then the macron last, as UJIpenchars2's native Spanish writers draw the marks of é and ñ (UCI Machine Learning Repository dataset 177, CC BY 4.0) <https://github.com/Medien-Treibhaus/grundschrift-app-source/blob/f6dbd807adbb3fc2f94207fe578def439f6e9c49/assets/levels/kleinbuchstaben/e/metadata.json>. Source notes on variation: s: The Grundschrift-App was made in a research project of the Laborschule at Bielefeld University with the Grundschulverband, on its Grundschrift school model, with a teacher advisory team. Each letter is an ordered list of paths, one per pen-down stroke, which the app makes a child trace in order. It writes s in one stroke, from the top right: anticlockwise over the top, then clockwise round the bottom to the lower left. UJIpenchars2 (Prat, Castro, Llorens, Marzal and Vilar; UCI Machine Learning Repository dataset 177, CC BY 4.0) holds 120 tablet pen traces of s, two by each of 60 adult Spanish writers; only counts are cited. 117 of the 120 are one stroke, and 76 of those 117 start at the top right. The app's repository has no licence, so only the order, the start, the direction and the lifts are taken from it; no point is copied, and the path is fitted to the s of the bundled LatinPrint-Subset.ttf, a renamed subset of SIL Global's literacy typeface Andika 7.000, which prints the one-storey a the school model teaches; the book's own text face is a different font. Handwriting varies by writer. a: The Grundschrift-App was made in a research project of the Laborschule at Bielefeld University with the Grundschulverband, on its Grundschrift school model, with a teacher advisory team. Each letter is an ordered list of paths, one per pen-down stroke, which the app makes a child trace in order. It writes the one-storey a in one stroke: anticlockwise round the bowl from the top right, back up to the top of the stem, and down the stem to the foot. The printed a joins the bowl to the stem, so the path runs back up the stem to its top before it comes down, as the source does. UJIpenchars2 (Prat, Castro, Llorens, Marzal and Vilar; UCI Machine Learning Repository dataset 177, CC BY 4.0) holds 120 tablet pen traces of a, two by each of 60 adult Spanish writers; only counts are cited. 118 of the 120 are one stroke, the source's count; 92 of those 118 start at the top (72 top centre, 20 top right), and 111 go anticlockwise round the bowl. The app's repository has no licence, so only the order, the start, the direction and the lifts are taken from it; no point is copied, and the path is fitted to the a of the bundled LatinPrint-Subset.ttf, a renamed subset of SIL Global's literacy typeface Andika 7.000, which prints the one-storey a the school model teaches; the book's own text face is a different font. Handwriting varies by writer. l: The Grundschrift-App was made in a research project of the Laborschule at Bielefeld University with the Grundschulverband, on its Grundschrift school model, with a teacher advisory team. Each letter is an ordered list of paths, one per pen-down stroke, which the app makes a child trace in order. It writes l in one stroke, down from the top. Grundschrift ends the stroke with a small hook to the right that the bundled outline does not print, so the path ends where the printed letter ends. UJIpenchars2 (Prat, Castro, Llorens, Marzal and Vilar; UCI Machine Learning Repository dataset 177, CC BY 4.0) holds 120 tablet pen traces of l, two by each of 60 adult Spanish writers; only counts are cited. All 120 are one stroke, the source's count, but 93 of them start at the bottom left and loop up, as a joined hand does; 9 start at the top left, as the school model does. The app's repository has no licence, so only the order, the start, the direction and the lifts are taken from it; no point is copied, and the path is fitted to the l of the bundled LatinPrint-Subset.ttf, a renamed subset of SIL Global's literacy typeface Andika 7.000, which prints the one-storey a the school model teaches; the book's own text face is a different font. Handwriting varies by writer. v: The Grundschrift-App was made in a research project of the Laborschule at Bielefeld University with the Grundschulverband, on its Grundschrift school model, with a teacher advisory team. Each letter is an ordered list of paths, one per pen-down stroke, which the app makes a child trace in order. It writes v in one stroke from the top left: down to the point on the line, then up to the top right. UJIpenchars2 (Prat, Castro, Llorens, Marzal and Vilar; UCI Machine Learning Repository dataset 177, CC BY 4.0), the native-writer corroboration of the earlier letters, could not be reached when v was added, so no native-writer count is cited for it. The app's repository has no licence, so only the order, the start, the direction and the lifts are taken from it; no point is copied, and the path is fitted to the v of the bundled LatinPrint-Subset.ttf, a renamed subset of SIL Global's literacy typeface Andika 7.000, which prints the one-storey a the school model teaches; the book's own text face is a different font. Handwriting varies by writer. ē: ORDER BY ANALOGY, NOT SEPARATELY SOURCED. No source reachable here records how ē is written: the Grundschrift-App has no letter with this mark, and UJIpenchars2 holds Spanish characters only. So its order is drawn by analogy with the cited é and ñ. UJIpenchars2 (Prat, Castro, Llorens, Marzal and Vilar; UCI Machine Learning Repository dataset 177, CC BY 4.0) finds the accent of é drawn last, after the e, in all 120 of its traces, and the tilde of ñ last, after the n, in all 108 where it is a separate mark (104 of them from left to right). ē is therefore the Grundschrift-App's e (level kleinbuchstaben/e, commit f6dbd80; no licence, facts only), then the macron after it. No source reachable here records the direction of this mark, so it is drawn left to right and top to bottom, the direction these records give every mark no cited record covers. The macron is a level bar, so it runs from left to right, as ñ's cited tilde does. Only the order, the start, the direction and the lifts are claimed, and only by analogy; no point is copied, and the path is fitted to the ē of the bundled LatinPrint-Subset.ttf, a renamed subset of SIL Global's literacy typeface Andika 7.000, which prints the one-storey a the school model teaches; the book's own text face is a different font. Handwriting varies by writer.
svg.text: How it is written — 5 letters, one after another
Letter 1 of 5 — one
unbroken stroke · 1
movement
Letter 2 of 5 — one unbroken stroke · 2 movements
Letter 3 of 5 — one
unbroken stroke · 1
movement
Letter 4 of 5 — one
unbroken stroke · 1
movement
Letter 5 of 5 — 2 strokes · 1 pen lift · 3 movements
Letter 1: stroke order after Grundschrift-App (Laborschule Bielefeld, Bielefeld University, with the Grundschulverband), level kleinbuchstaben/s, ordered stroke
paths for s (assets/levels/kleinbuchstaben/s/metadata.json, commit f6dbd80; no licence, facts only)
Letter 2: stroke order after Grundschrift-App (Laborschule Bielefeld, Bielefeld University, with the Grundschulverband), level kleinbuchstaben/a, ordered stroke
paths for a (assets/levels/kleinbuchstaben/a/metadata.json, commit f6dbd80; no licence, facts only)
Letter 3: stroke order after Grundschrift-App (Laborschule Bielefeld, Bielefeld University, with the Grundschulverband), level kleinbuchstaben/l, ordered stroke
paths for l (assets/levels/kleinbuchstaben/l/metadata.json, commit f6dbd80; no licence, facts only)
Letter 4: stroke order after Grundschrift-App (Laborschule Bielefeld, Bielefeld University, with the Grundschulverband), level kleinbuchstaben/v, ordered stroke
paths for v (assets/levels/kleinbuchstaben/v/metadata.json, commit f6dbd80; no licence, facts only)
Letter 5: stroke order after By analogy with the cited é and ñ, not separately sourced: the e after the Grundschrift-App, level kleinbuchstaben/e
(assets/levels/kleinbuchstaben/e/metadata.json, commit f6dbd80; no licence, facts only), then the macron last, as UJIpenchars2's native Spanish writers draw the
marks of é and ñ (UCI Machine Learning Repository dataset 177, CC BY 4.0)
This order is attested, not standardised; the source records where it varies.
